policy: All rows require String instType/instId and numeric algoId or ordId; orders requires present String clOrdId. All other fields optional. Absent != empty != zero. Validate discarded metadata, no coercion. Local resource caps per brief. No financial authority.

rulings.R1: Parent approved String only linkedAlgoOrd.algoId despite original Object table type; reject other types.
rulings.R2: Parent approved exactly optional String closeFraction/quickMgnType in algo WS, example-only with REST corroboration.
rulings.routing: Original algo control is routing-negative. Synthetic positive changes arg only.
rulings.replacement: Terminal adapter; later 3G owns protected replacement.
